howDoesItWork.title: How Does It Work?
howDoesItWork.subtitle: Get expert guidance in just a few simple steps

step1.title: Login to the Website
step1.description: Start by creating an account or logging in to access our platform and explore expert services.

step2.title: Choose Your Area & Topic
step2.description: Select the category (Wellness, Education, or Finance) and the specific topic where you need expert guidance.

step3.title: Browse Experts & Select a Slot
step3.description: Explore our verified experts in your chosen field, view their profiles, and book an available time slot that works for you.

step4.title: Get Your Session
step4.description: Enjoy a free demo session if available, or pay for a 1-hour live one-on-one session with your chosen expert.
